leadText:
Hibana (Japanese: ヒバナ Hibana) is a recurring character in . She is an .

She first appeared in Serving Up the Flute Cup!, where she starred in a promotional spot for the Battle Frontier Flute Cup, in which she presented the prize of the tournament: a set of all five flutes. She also invited s to enter the competition. Hibana later awarded his prizes at the award ceremony after he defeated Hodge in the final round.

Hibana reappeared during a promotional video in Restore and Renew!, where she presented a special exhibit of a at the Pewter Museum of Science.
